title: penstemon heterophyllus subsp. typicus
intro: Penstemon heterophyllus subsp. typicus, commonly known as California beardtongue, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the western United States. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Penstemon heterophyllus subsp. typicus include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
